methods_quotes.q: Both NHANES III and NHANES 1999 used a stratified, multistage probability sample of the civilian, U.S. noninstitutionalized population.
Serum and RBC folate were measured by the same analyst in the NHANES Central Laboratory for both NHANES III and NHANES 1999.
The overall > 6 year mean coefficient of variation for serum and RBC folate was 5%.
